host: Windows x64; native MSVC/Windows SDK build is the primary route
seed_provenance: The 12 existing runtime.json seeds are prior Linux diagnostic observations. The additional window procedure seed is a SHA-bound static candidate: value 0x00480A50 is stored at 0x0048089F into the WNDCLASSEXA lpfnWndProc field, passed to RegisterClassExA at 0x004808F0. Rechecked against the supplied input; not runtime-observed Windows execution.
limitations: This metadata does not recover every indirect target or missing API.
No dependency on the unavailable local-only discovery implementation.
Actual E3 Windows build/startup/frame/control results must be recorded separately; a synthetic fixture is not E3 evidence.
New startup roots were observed through Wine on Linux, not through native Windows; they are bounded profile metadata, not a complete indirect-flow recovery claim.
